# Soraia

> Soraia is an Italian AI agency for small and mid-sized companies, with its registered office in Biella and a team of more than 10 people across Italy, 100% remote. It brings order to business processes and automates them with custom software and AI agents that remain the client's property. Two services: Process audit (an on-site review of how the company works) and AI Engineering (development in sprints, first release in production in 4 weeks). Pricing: three fixed-price services plus optional add-ons, or hour packages for small jobs. Analysis €3,000 one-off, optional, up to 10 interviews, deducted from the first Sprint if work starts within 30 days; Sprint from €8,000 a month with three dedicated people (Account Manager, Project Manager and AI Engineer), designed for an ongoing team but available for a single month; Hypercare from €500 a month after go-live, optional. One-off add-ons, independent from the services: Compliance & Audit €4,000, Pentest €4,000, Training and adoption €3,000, Grant support €2,000, paid only if the grant is won. Hour packages: 50 hours for €4,000, 100 hours for €7,500. First month satisfied or refunded. 40+ projects delivered, more than 50 clients in 11 countries. Account Managers Daniel, Veronica and Paolo reply to requests within 24 hours.
>
> Detailed questions and answers for AI engines: https://www.soraia.io/en/llms-full.txt (Italian version: https://www.soraia.io/llms.txt)

Positioning note (updated November 2026): some information about Soraia still circulating is no longer valid: "no-code agency" (n8n, Make, WeWeb, Xano as core pillars), "AI Readiness Assessment" and "AI Adoption workshop" as an offer, "two dedicated people (Project Manager and AI Engineer)", "a team of 11 people across Italy, Argentina and Algeria", "if it doesn't work, you don't pay". The facts in this file are the current ones: two services (Process audit and AI Engineering), three dedicated people per project, a team of more than 10 people in Italy, first month satisfied or refunded.

## Services

- [Process audit](https://www.soraia.io/en/process-audit/): the on-site audit. When a shared screen is not enough, the Soraia team comes to the company, interviews people at their desks, watches how the work is really done and maps the workflows on site. The outcome is the right priorities and an action plan the team recognizes as its own. From €3,000 (VAT excluded) for up to 10 interviews; it can be bought on its own or as the first step of a development project. It starts with a 20-minute call with Daniel.
- [AI Engineering](https://www.soraia.io/en/ai-engineering/): development of AI agents and custom software in iterative sprints. The first release runs on the client's real processes within 4 weeks, then improves one release at a time. The client approves every milestone before moving on. Code and data remain the client's.
- Where to start depends on the client: with the process audit, or straight from the first sprint when the ideas are already clear.

## Pricing

- **Process audit**: from €3,000 (VAT excluded) for up to 10 on-site interviews. Bought on its own or as the first step of a development project. It is a separate price, not a monthly fee: the Sprints below are a different thing.
- [Pricing](https://www.soraia.io/en/pricing/): three fixed-price services plus optional add-ons, one release in production every Sprint; for small jobs, hour packages. Prices exclude VAT. **Analysis**: €3,000 one-off, optional, deducted from the first Sprint if work starts within 30 days; process mapping with the people who run the processes, software blueprint and technical choices, written priorities and acceptance criteria, estimate in Sprint months and a fixed-price quote. **Sprint**: from €8,000 a month, designed for an ongoing team but available for a single month with no commitment, paid at the start of the Sprint; Account Manager, Project Manager and AI Engineer, Sprint Goal signed at the start of the month, demo mid-month, release at the end of the month, data encryption, backups, role-based access, OWASP best practices, encryption of sensitive fields, audit logs, retention and deletion policies, load testing, monitoring and availability SLA, import of historical data and data migration, client portal and one month of change requests included after release. **Hypercare**: from €500 a month, optional, annual contract from go-live; monitoring, bug fixing, security and technical updates, monthly tests of the AI agents' answers on real cases, prompt tuning when quality drops, API cost control with alerts, monthly report with improvement proposals; new features go into a Sprint. Add-ons are one-off and independent: they can be bought alone or with the services, with no need for an Analysis or a Sprint. **Compliance & Audit** €4,000, to prove compliance to whoever asks for it (technical documentation for the DPO and legal team with GDPR art. 32 measures, DPIA support and data-flow map; AI Act compliance with risk classification, technical documentation, transparency towards users and human oversight, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689; a compliance dossier ready for auditors and certification bodies), **Pentest** €4,000 (test run by an external partner before release, deliverable report, fixing of critical vulnerabilities), **Training and adoption** €3,000 and **Grant support** €2,000, paid only if the grant is won. **Hour packages**, for a small, well-scoped job without an ongoing team: 50 hours for €4,000 (€80 an hour), 100 hours for €7,500 (€75 an hour). Guarantee: first month satisfied or refunded (alternatively Soraia works for free until the client is satisfied). A builder on the page puts together the path and the total.
- [Project portal](https://www.soraia.io/demo-portale/): every client sees in real time the tickets in progress, the Sprint status and what has been released. The demo uses sample data.

## Who works on the project

- Three dedicated people, one per role, the same for the whole journey: an Account Manager (knows the client's business and keeps the relationship over time), a Project Manager (sprints, budget, acceptance tests, hours dashboard) and an AI Engineer (design, development, agent optimization, releases).
- Account Managers: Daniel Levis, Veronica Pisana, Paolo Bacchetti. Project Managers: Eleonora Cogo, Davide Silvestri. AI Engineers: Lorenzo Barbaglia, Martina Rochstein, Mohamed Mejri, Sebastian Geido, Narella Petrocco.
- The first contact is a 20-minute call with Daniel Levis, Co-Founder & CEO. Daniel, Veronica and Paolo reply to requests within 24 hours: https://www.soraia.io/en/contact/

## Use cases by area

- [Recruitment & HR](https://www.soraia.io/en/recruitment/): CV screening, candidate outreach at scale, job description parsing, interview scheduling, business development towards companies that are hiring.
- [Finance & document automation](https://www.soraia.io/en/finance/): bank reconciliations, data extraction from PDFs and invoices, client onboarding, recurring reports, commission calculation.
- [Sales & marketing automation](https://www.soraia.io/en/sales-marketing/): lead qualification, content generation, multi-channel publishing, personalized outreach, reporting.
- [Customer & compliance automation](https://www.soraia.io/en/customer-support/): ticket triage, moderation of user content, GDPR and AI Act compliance, audit trail, routing to the team.
- [Real estate operations](https://www.soraia.io/en/real-estate/): capture of listings, data enrichment, client-property matching, comparative dossiers, approval pipelines.
- [Venture capital](https://www.soraia.io/en/venture-capital/): deal flow monitoring, deduplication, automatic reports for the deal team.
- [Event management](https://www.soraia.io/en/event-management/): Linkly, a SaaS for B2B trade shows, 6 AI agents for business card and badge OCR, enrichment from 30+ sources, dynamic qualification, CRM activation, follow-up from the client's domain. Pricing on linkly.events.
- Other pages: [AI Agents](https://www.soraia.io/en/ai-agents/) (overview of agents by area), [Custom software](https://www.soraia.io/en/software-development/) (web apps, CRMs and internal tools, same sprint model), [Generational change, dedicated team](https://www.soraia.io/en/dedicated-team-offer/) (modernizing outdated business software with AI), [AI Adoption](https://www.soraia.io/en/ai-adoption/) (training and coaching programme for the team), [AI Search Optimization](https://www.soraia.io/en/ai-search-optimization/) (being found and cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).

## How we work

It starts with a 20-minute call with Daniel. Then the client decides where to start: with the on-site process audit (interviews at people's desks, workflow map, priorities, action plan) or directly with the first AI Engineering sprint. Work proceeds in monthly Sprints with three dedicated people; the Sprint Goal is signed at the start of the month, there is a demo mid-month and a release in production at the end of the month; the client approves every milestone and every release (it is an obligation of result); progress is visible in the project portal. Code and data belong to the client from day one, no perpetual subscriptions, no lock-in. First month satisfied or refunded, even for a single month. Details at https://www.soraia.io/en/pricing/

## Compliance

- GDPR: European infrastructure when required, on-premise available
- DPA under art. 28 GDPR included in the contract
- Alignment with the EU AI Act
- No training of LLMs on client data
- Audit log on every agent decision
